title: The Federal Budget Pie
prompt: You are the President. Allocate exactly 100% of the tax revenue. Balance baseline national security with public infrastructure investments.
success_text: Success! You maintained baseline security while investing heavily in future human capital. Long-term GDP projections look strong.
fail_text: Failure. Your allocation triggered civic unrest due to social cuts, or underfunded research completely tanked innovation.

title: The Global Trade Dilemma
prompt: Domestic manufacturing is declining, but implementing high broad tariffs will trigger retaliatory measures from trading partners. Choose the optimal policy action:

choices.text: Enact targeted subsidies for domestic R&D instead of aggressive border tariffs.
Impose a flat 25% tariff on all imported goods across the board.
Completely deregulate all environmental and labor standards to cut manufacturing costs.

success_text: Correct decision! Subsidies boosted domestic efficiency and preserved vital international trade agreements without triggering a consumer price spike.
fail_text: Incorrect strategy. Aggressive broad tariffs triggered a devastating retaliatory trade war, doubling consumer electronics prices and hurting agriculture exports.
